facts.fact: A court handed down a four-year prison sentence in February 2025 to a man convicted of insulting and defaming state leaders, per a Sudan News Agency post of 10 February 2025 cited by Freedom House.
facts.system: Four-year sentence for insulting and defaming state leaders

facts.fact: Sudanese military arrested journalist after he criticised a governor over the water crisis, per a CPJ report of 24 July 2024 cited by Freedom House.
facts.system: Journalist arrested for criticising a governor on the water crisis

facts.fact: Journalist Abdul Jalil Mohammed Abdul Jalil was arrested for exposing corruption in the Hajj pilgrimage, per a Sudan Barq report of 26 May 2025 cited by Freedom House.

systems.country_label: Freedom on the Net 2025: Sudan 27 of 100, not free

note: No cut fact: the year-long Wad Madani blackout lifted January 2025 and the Khartoum outage are tied to the RSF takeover and fighting, not to an order of government, regulator or security forces; score is other.
